title: Natural number
summary: Natural numbers model finite counting through zero and repeated successor.

content.plain: Natural numbers model finite counting through zero and repeated successor.
content.exact: A Peano presentation gives N, 0, successor S, injectivity and nonzero-successor axioms, plus an induction principle or second-order categoricity condition.
content.caveat: First-order Peano arithmetic has nonstandard models; ‘the’ natural numbers require a chosen characterization.
